lines.text: Ren. You are up before the kettle.
I wanted to see the street again.
It has not changed. It never does, and then one morning it has.

choices.text: Tell her your body has stopped

lines.text: Come here. Not from your father's tin. From mine.
Twenty-five Steps. Enough to cross the road, not enough for the city.
I will pay it back.
You will not. That is not what it is for.
Walk where people can see you. Not the back lane.
Ren. Look at me. Look at me.
She takes your hand. It does not close around hers.
Thirty Steps. Do not waste them standing here.
The clock started.
I know. Move.
If it happens again, come to me before you look at the sky.
The sign by the crossing is counting again.
It has counted for thirty years. People stop seeing it.
What happens when it reaches zero?
The body stops. Then you have one day to finish your sentence.
Do not let it finish for you.
Eat something before the road.
I will.
You always say that.
